text_block_list.text:
After the Takarazuka Kinen, Winning Ticket and I
pondered together what Biwa Hayahide's words meant.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What's the difference between who I was at the Derby and who I am now?
choice_data_list: If I remember right, you had a scary dream before the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, totally! I remember!
I got so scared back then!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't help it.
It's the Derby I've always dreamed of.
I just really, really didn't want to lose.
...You definitely don't want to lose...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...It seems losing that final battle against me
hit them pretty hard.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I really think a practice race would be way better than training alone, though.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, that race earlier
was really great."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...A good race?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That dead heat between Taishin and Hayahide at the end
was absolutely electric!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Everyone's saying it was a heated race too~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think so too?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Even though you suffered defeat...

Precisely because Winning Ticket had always been
so "serious," I failed to notice it.
Yet something truly precious had undoubtedly changed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Wh-What's this all of a sudden?
What do you mean by feelings?
choice_data_list: It's that feeling of absolutely not wanting to lose!
That feeling of absolutely not wanting to lose!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I absolutely... don't want to lose... this feeling...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Maybe I had the wrong idea.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in an awesome race like the Derby.
Where rivals give it their all competing against each other,
and the audience watching is deeply moved...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That I'd be satisfied if I could run a race like that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Maybe I lost that feeling I had at the Derby... that absolute desire to win, that refusal to lose.
choice_data_list: That feeling is what truly matters, though.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Ah, so that was it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If you run thinking it's fine as long as you just run a great race,
it's never gonna be the best race ever.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I won't lose! I'll be number one no matter what!
It's because everyone clashes with that kind of passion
that races like that Derby are possible..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Both Taishin and Hayahide give it their all to win,
and that's why they both keep getting stronger and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The reason I stopped being a rival was because I wasn't taking winning seriously...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I... I want to win!
Against Taishin and Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"No, not just the two of them... not to anyone!!
I don't want to lose to anyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to win any race and show the crowd
what it truly means to be the absolute greatest!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Because that's—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Because it's a dream I've wanted to fulfill for so, sooooo long!!!!!!!!
Her powerful declaration strikes a deep chord in my heart.

"Just like that time she first told me
about her dream—!"
choice_data_list: Then let's aim for the ultimate stage!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The best stage...?
choice_data_list: It's the year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen!
It's the year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO~H!
The Arima Kinen, birthplace of so many legendary clashes!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'm definitely going to win with a race that goes down in legend!
So for training—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oops, before that, there's something important I have to do! Just wait a sec~~~~!!

Winning Ticket ran off,
and I hurriedly chased after her.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin!! Hayahide!!
Race against meee!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pass.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No passing allowed!
The loser buys juice, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Ticket.
If it's training that's just fun, right now――"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No holding back either!!
Both of you are competing with me today!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Please, I'm begging you!! There's something
I just have to tell you two no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Experience tells me that when things get like this, we have no choice but to yield.
You know that all too well yourself, don't you, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's a deal!!
Alright... on your maaaarks, get set, GOOO!!!
The wind was hot, and the sky was clear.

The impromptu race had only 100 meters left,
and the battle was fiercely contested.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (The sheer spirit from both of them! They're so fast!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Still!!
Like hell I'm gonna looooose—!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket...! 
Ha... That's my line...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna pass both of you!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!!

Winning Ticket is the very first to launch into her final spurt.
As if chasing after her, the other two shift gears as well.

text_block_list.name: BNW
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAH!!!!

Summoning every last ounce of their strength,
the three of them plunged toward the finish line—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa............gh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I wiiiiin!!!

The three of them sank to their knees, collapsing to the ground,
and for a while, no one spoke a word.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Hayahide, Taishin. ...Turns out,
I really wasn't a rival to you two at all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Especially as of late.
Because I had forgotten... the single most important thing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So today! Let me say it once more!
—My feelings, with all my might!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Let us hear it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide! How you analyze the entire race,
so cool and collected yet burning with passion—I love that about you!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So――I don't want to lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin! The burst on your late charge is crazy good,
insane, terrifying, and I totally love it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So――I don't want to lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You two are the rivals I love the most,
and respect the most in the whole world...
That's why you're the ones I want to beat more than anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm entering the next Arima Kinen.
Would you compete against me there?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
As a "Rival," I want to have—
a dead-serious, all-out showdown with both of them!!
Seeing Winning Ticket's serious gaze, Biwa Hayahide narrowed her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
..."Rivals," huh.
You have that look in your eyes that I know all too well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Understood.
I'll run in the Arima Kinen. It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...! H-Hayahideee~...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...There's something
I have to do."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: To do that, I don't have time to play nice with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
Competing against Ticket and Hayahide is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I think it'll be a plus for me, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Does that mean, does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...At the 'Arima Kinen',
if you run like a coward, I will seriously kick your ass."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: MINISTERRRRRRRRRRR!!
Winning Ticket energetically leaped into Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gah!? H-Hey, dummy, you're suffocatingly hot...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!
Let's do our best together
heading into the Arima Kinennnnnn!!
Winning Ticket's energetic voice echoed into the blue sky—and BNW became "rivals" once more.
